title: Top Improvements in Business Central Page Scripting in Release 2025 Wave 2
summary: Page Scripting tool in Business Central 2025 Wave 2 adds features to manage and edit recorded scripts more flexibly, including step deletion, insertion, reordering, parameter management, and script composition - addressing pain points from manual YAML editing and full re-recording requirements.
key_points: Users can now delete individual steps from scripts without re-recording the entire process
Scripts support parameter management directly in the UI instead of requiring manual YAML file editing
Multiple scripts can be combined and imported through the UI with parameter passing between them
Steps can be reordered via drag-and-drop and new steps can be inserted at any point in the workflow
These improvements reduce the need for manual script editing and full re-recording when changes are needed
